trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task.

steps.text: Play the story to the end, then work the cleanup list; every other trophy feeds this one.
Track the 100% completion checklist in game (Touch Pad > Progress) — A Long Road is usually the last trophy before this one.
Expect a long run: launch guides put the platinum at about 200 hours, while Push Square warns it can pass 300 hours.

tips: Time estimates disagree: ~200 hours (KeenGamer, PowerPyx via EGamers) vs 300+ hours (Push Square) — treat both as rough ranges, not promises.
No online trophies: the whole set is single-player and offline.
Cheats disable trophies and saving for the session, so keep them off until the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story beat, and it cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play Gone Fishing from the start of the game; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
No preparation is needed — story trophies unlock automatically as you play.

tips: The first trophy most players earn; Exophase shows it as the most common early unlock.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's meditation invitation at Jason's house — it may be the game's only missable moment (see Positive Mental Attitude).

tips: Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2; it pops automatically at the chapter's end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2.
Garage purchases open through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver — buy garages as you go for Little Boxes.

tips: The Scooter Bros app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses — register cheap stolen cars early for On the Spot.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; it pops automatically at the chapter's end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3.
Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun — the quiet way into jewelry stores for Sneakthief.

tips: Chapter 3 progress also opens Standard Tracker vehicle registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4; it pops automatically at the chapter's end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4.
Take the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock large bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.

tips: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4 — the final mission follows soon after.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist opens.

steps.text: Finish the final story mission.
After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what cleanup remains.

tips: Free-roam continues after the story, so nothing in cleanup is locked behind the ending.

steps.text: Play Breakfast Run when it appears in the story.
It unlocks automatically — no side requirement.

tips: Chapter placement follows the official list order; not yet checked in game.

steps.text: Play The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story.
Story mission — it unlocks automatically.

tips: Chapter placement follows the official list order; not yet checked in game.

steps.text: Play Child's Play when it appears in the story.

steps.text: Play VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist — the longest grind in the set, and usually the last gold before the platinum.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the 100% checklist opens afterwards at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist's big blocks: 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, all 8 large bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Guides disagree on total time: about 200 hours (KeenGamer) versus 300+ hours (Push Square) — either way, this is the platinum's long pole.

tips: Hardest trophy in the set by consensus of the launch guides.
Progress earned during the story already counts toward the checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count.

steps.text: Mix the four stunt types (Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights, Base Jumps) and pick the easiest ones first.
Keep going past 250 if you want 100%: the completion checklist needs 300 stunts.

tips: Track progress at any time with Touch Pad > Progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — one round of everything is enough.

steps.text: Open the map and try one of each activity type (races, shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, and the rest).
One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them all.

tips: Nine activity types in total, per KeenGamer; the exact nine are not yet confirmed in game — try anything the map marks as an activity.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the hardest skill trophy after A Long Road.

steps.text: Visit every shooting range and work its challenges until each shows gold.
42 gold medals in total; there is no shortcut — each challenge must be golded individually.

tips: Named a joint-hardest trophy alongside A Long Road by GamesFuze.
Learn each range's layout on the easier targets first — not yet checked in game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations.

steps.text: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of its 14 locations and win once at each.
A win at a new location counts immediately — repeat wins at the same spot do not help.

tips: 14 locations in total; the map marks each venue — not yet checked in game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race won 20 times does not count.

steps.text: Win 20 distinct races across Leonida's race types.
Vary the events: each new race you win adds one; repeats add nothing.

tips: Try races during the story too — wins count whenever they happen.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The exact meeting point is not yet confirmed — treat any specific spot as unchecked.

steps.text: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge; the precise rules are not yet confirmed in game.

tips: Method unconfirmed: no launch guide yet pins down Cal's location or the challenge rules — do not trust a specific spot until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, any game.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet and play one game to completion.
Finishing is what counts, not a high score.

tips: The quickest activity trophy if an arcade is nearby.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — his strand ends with Puff Puff Pass.

steps.text: Play Andy's stranger missions until his final one, Puff Puff Pass.
Finish that mission to close Andy's strand.

tips: Andy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — track the 8 qualifying strands separately.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Play Kenton's stranger missions until his final one.
Finish that mission to close Kenton's strand.

tips: Stranger finals unlock as you meet each character in free-roam and story play.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Play Billy's stranger missions until his final one.
Finish that mission to close Billy's strand.

tips: Billy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — track the 8 qualifying strands separately.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — but not every stranger counts.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines do NOT count toward this trophy.
Use the in-game tracker for stranger strands instead of counting every optional contact.

tips: The exclusion of Andy, Billy and Tyrone is the trophy's main trap — their own trophies are separate.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Play Randy's stranger missions until his final one.
Finish that mission to close Randy's strand.

tips: Stranger finals unlock as you meet each character in free-roam and story play.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Play Tyrone's stranger missions until his final one.
Finish that mission to close Tyrone's strand.

tips: Tyrone's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — track the 8 qualifying strands separately.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. The only trophy any launch guide flags as possibly missable.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, check Jason's house in the morning: when Lucia mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Do that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 — the invitation becomes unavailable afterwards, and whether it is required is still unconfirmed.
Then meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida until all 18 are done.

tips: Flagged as possibly missable by GTABase and PowerPyx (via EGamers) and by KeenGamer — the only trophy with that flag.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 until this is confirmed safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal and where are not yet confirmed — treat any specific target as unchecked.

steps.text: Meet Bret and take his hunting request.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names; the exact species and location are not yet confirmed.

tips: Method unconfirmed: no launch guide yet pins down the animal or the spot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — any three of the 18 sets in the game.

steps.text: Collect cards around Leonida and finish any 3 complete sets.
There are 18 sets in total; 100% completion needs 15, but this trophy only needs 3.

tips: Keep card sets in separate tracking notes — sets are easy to mix up.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — scan places with the WAiNK app as you explore.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app and scan unfamiliar locations while travelling.
100 different locations count; repeats do not.

tips: Scan constantly during the story — it costs nothing and the count carries over.
Vehicle scans and location scans are separate objectives; do not mix them.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — any 50 of the 80 on the map.

steps.text: Clear any 50 of the 80 challenges across Leonida.
100% completion needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road.

tips: Challenges overlap with stunts and races — many complete themselves while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat — clearing the flashing search area alone is not enough.

steps.text: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you.
Escape the red heat zone entirely, not just the flashing search area.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County gives cover from helicopters and makes pursuit harder.

tips: Pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal: bank vault robberies trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — the trick is keeping the pursuit alive between shops.

steps.text: With your partner, rob a shop, then move straight to the next while the red-and-blue flashing pursuit is still active.
Do not let the Wanted Level drop between shops — merely staying inside the red heat zone without an active Wanted Level does not count.
The trophy can unlock about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so do not abandon a good run immediately.

tips: Watch tier: the description reads as unmissable in free-roam, but the pursuit-timing rule is easy to break — treat it as failable until confirmed.
Plan three nearby shops in advance so the gaps stay short.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan unfamiliar ones with the WAiNK app as you travel.

steps.text: Use the WAiNK app to scan vehicles you have not seen before.
100 discoveries count; 100% completion needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past 100.

tips: Vehicle scans and location scans are separate counts.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus.
Use an assault rifle on a clustered group of gang enemies, and let Adrenaline stretch the focus time.

tips: Pick a fight with a dense group — five spread-out enemies will not fall inside one focus bar.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a boarded passenger plane and fly it out.

steps.text: At VCIA, find a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge — the one at terminals E3/E4 works.
Enter, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the unlock can be delayed.

tips: A parked plane with no boarding bridge does not count — it must be a boarded one.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description points at the Rhino tank, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank and get inside or take one on, as the description hints.
The precise unlock condition is not yet confirmed in game — treat any specific method as unchecked.

tips: Method unconfirmed: no launch guide yet pins down what counts as the trigger.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — quiet entry, quiet safe, no alarm.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door, find the safe-code note inside, and open the safe quietly — kicking the door triggers the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a suitable target.

tips: Watch tier: a single alarm fails the run, so save before you try and retry quietly.
If you are spotted, leave and reset rather than fighting through it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — big vaults, with your partner, under a 4-star response.

steps.text: Take the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock large bank vault robberies.
Follow a security van to a bank and enter while the guard has the vault open — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the cash bags alone.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; 100% completion needs all 8.

tips: Each robbery triggers a 4-star Wanted Level, so it overlaps with Hot Together.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape — then clear the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

steps.text: Find an armored truck, rob it, and get away.
Escape the red heat zone entirely — clearing the immediate flashing search area is not enough.

tips: The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County gives cover from helicopters during the escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total.

steps.text: Visit every one of the 52 areas across the state.
Check the in-game map for unvisited regions and sweep them in free-roam.

tips: Exploration during the story counts — areas you pass through already register.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, nine gangs in total.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
100% completion needs all 39 operations, so keep raiding past the trophy.

tips: Track gangs, not just operations — a second hit on the same gang adds nothing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Which bar counts is not yet confirmed — treat any specific venue as unchecked.

steps.text: Go to Ocean Beach and find a spot serving cocktails with a view.
Order and enjoy the cocktail there; the exact venue is not yet confirmed in game.

tips: Method unconfirmed: no launch guide yet names the venue — do not trust a specific bar until one confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the exact showroom and trigger are not yet confirmed.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom, then smash your way out through the front in classic style.
The precise trigger is not yet confirmed in game — treat any specific showroom as unchecked.

tips: Method unconfirmed: no launch guide yet pins down the showroom or the trigger.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — in practice, a robbery with three valuables to grab.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.

Steal the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe contents in the northeast hallway office — bring Sticky Bombs for the safe — then escape the police.
Valuables already collected still count if you return during a later robbery.

tips: Despite the name, this one plays as a heist, not a bowling game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia.

steps.text: Train Strength with Jason until it is maxed.
Do the same with Lucia; visit fitness clubs together so the inactive partner trains alongside the one you control.

tips: Training together is the efficient route — solo sessions only raise one partner at a time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

steps.text: Build 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; robberies and enemy encounters contribute naturally.
Leave this one until other jobs are finished — the count usually fills itself during normal play.

tips: Watch tier: the count is long and opaque, so check the Criminal Profile screen regularly — a separate grind may not be needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description hints at succeeding on a retry, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.

steps.text: The description points at a second attempt succeeding where the first failed.
No launch guide yet confirms which event counts — treat any specific method as unchecked.

tips: Method unconfirmed: do not chase a specific retry until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description hints at something strange, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.

steps.text: The description points at an unusual event somewhere in Leonida.
No launch guide yet confirms what it is — treat any specific location or event as unchecked.

tips: Method unconfirmed: the name suggests a UFO-style easter egg, but that is a guess, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the precise method is still being confirmed by the launch guides.

steps.text: Perform a melee drive-by elimination, as the description states.
The precise method is still being confirmed — treat any specific setup as unchecked.

tips: Method unconfirmed: KeenGamer lists the precise method as still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

tips: Bank vaults and gang operations are steady sources of Marked Bills — launder as you go rather than stockpiling.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, food, gear, anything counts.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops.
Big purchases help: garages cost $160,000 in total, and shopping counts alongside them.

tips: It fills itself during a normal playthrough — check the total before buying anything big for fun.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable ones; the 4 story garages do not need buying.

steps.text: Open the Vice City Real Estate phone app — it becomes available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages; reserve their $160,000 total before spending freely.

tips: Only the 8 purchasable garages count; the 4 story garages are excluded.
Extra parking also supports On the Spot, since you need room to register vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Unlock the Scooter Bros app through the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
Take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register — cheap cars and bikes keep costs down.
At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later Chapter 3 progress permits Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations.

tips: Register as you steal — ten cheap registrations beat ten expensive ones.
